Q5735.reason: Federal claims on the face of the complaint make the case removable, the removal was timely, and supplemental jurisdiction covers the state claims, so the plaintiff's motive for removing does not require remand.

Q5750.reason: Visual impairment is common in people over 65 and can make reading screen-based sources difficult, which is the most direct accessibility concern of the options.

Q5130.reason: Arterial pulsation does not vary with posture, whereas venous pulsation changes with posture and is abolished by root-of-neck compression or positive hepatojugular reflux.
